strategy.primary: Artifact/Ally flash-combo: cast artifacts and Allies at instant speed (combat tricks, end-step development, interaction) and assemble compact artifact wins: Basalt Monolith + Rings of Brighthearth, Sensei's Divining Top with Bolas's Citadel + Aetherflux or Mystic Forge + a cost reducer.
strategy.secondary: Firebending's combat mana pays for flashed artifacts and Allies; Breach + LED/Petal + Brain Freeze as a backup.
